title: The reduction tower of a complex with completed integral coefficients
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, a scheme $Y$, and put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$. Let $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ be the completed coefficient sheaf on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ with projections $\pi_n:\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\to(A_{E,n})_Y$, let $\rho_n:(A_{E,n+1})_Y\to(A_{E,n})_Y$ be the reduction maps, so that $\pi_n=\rho_n\pi_{n+1}$, and let $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ be the derived category of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$. Choose a quasi-isomorphism $q:P\to K$ from a K-flat complex of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex] (one exists [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]), so that the derived reduction $K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] is represented by $P_n=P\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}}(A_{E,n})_Y$ (termwise tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]), and let $\operatorname{Res}_n:D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ be the derived restriction of scalars [def-weil-integral-derived-restriction-of-scalars]; thus $K_n:=\operatorname{Res}_n(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n})$ is represented by $P_n$ read as a complex of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules via $\pi_n$. Termwise, the maps

$$
 \gamma_n:P\to P_n,\ x\mapsto x\otimes1,\qquad \tau_n=\mathrm{id}_P\otimes\rho_n:P_{n+1}\to P_n
$$

are morphisms of complexes of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules (because $\pi_n=\rho_n\pi_{n+1}$), and $\tau_n\circ\gamma_{n+1}=\gamma_n$. The *reduction tower* of $K$ is the inverse system $(K_n,t_n)_{n\geq1}$ in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ with transition maps $t_n=[\tau_n]:K_{n+1}\to K_n$, together with the morphisms

$$
 c_n=[\gamma_n]\circ[q]^{-1}:K\longrightarrow K_n,\qquad t_n\circ c_{n+1}=c_n,
$$

of $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$. Up to the isomorphisms of [lem-weil-integral-reduction-tower-well-defined], the system $(K_n,t_n)$ and the maps $c_n$ do not depend on the choice of $q:P\to K$.
